items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: We played in Storerville, one or two years.

ctx.x: I heard Fess talk about Zed a lot. Yeah. And Manuel Mineta.
Did you ever play with Manuel Mineta? Oh, yeah. We played in Storerville, one or two years.
I told him yesterday we were coming up to see you and he said to say hello to you.
